## 2027 Honda CR-V vs 2026 Toyota RAV4: Which Is Better for NYC Drivers?
Published September 30, 2026 · Last updated September 30, 2026
The 2027 Honda CR-V vs 2026 Toyota RAV4 decision is the biggest one in the compact SUV aisle, and New York City drivers feel the differences every day. The Honda CR-V gives you a choice of turbo gas or hybrid power, more back-seat room and more cargo space. The Toyota RAV4 is now hybrid-only, with higher EPA ratings and larger standard screens. The short answer: RAV4 for stop-and-go commuting, CR-V for families who need space.
Quick Verdict

## CR-V or RAV4: The Short Answer
*   **Choose the 2027 Honda CR-V** if you want the lowest entry price ($31,520 for a gas LX), the roomiest back seat (41.0 inches of legroom), up to 76.5 cubic feet of cargo space, and a moonroof or genuine leather-trimmed seats for less money.  
*   **Choose the 2026 Toyota RAV4** if fuel economy comes first: every RAV4 is a hybrid rated up to 47 mpg city, a hybrid RAV4 costs about $4,100 less than the cheapest CR-V Hybrid, and a 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster is standard.  
*   **Bottom line for NYC:** daily commuters on the BQE, LIE or FDR save the most fuel in the RAV4; families hauling strollers, car seats and luggage get more room in the CR-V.
**Model-year timing:** The 2027 Honda CR-V is on sale now and carries over the 2026 lineup, which received Honda's most recent updates; for 2027, the main change is pricing. The 2026 Toyota RAV4 is actually the newer design despite its model-year label: it is the all-new sixth generation that reached U.S. dealers from December 2025. As of September 30, 2026, Toyota has not announced U.S. pricing for the 2027 RAV4. Reports in early September said it is expected later this year and may add extra Multi-Terrain Select drive modes, but Toyota has not confirmed details. Bottom line: this is a fair comparison today, and a 2026 RAV4 in stock lets you shop current incentives without missing anything major. Read more about the 2027 Toyota RAV4 and what's changing and the 2026 vs 2027 Honda CR-V.

## Price and Value
The 2027 Honda CR-V is cheaper to get into, while the 2026 Toyota RAV4 is the cheaper way to get a hybrid. The CR-V LX starts at $31,520, $380 below the RAV4 LE, but the least expensive CR-V Hybrid (Sport Hybrid, $36,030) costs $4,130 more than a hybrid RAV4 LE with front-wheel drive.

## Price and Value
### 2027 Honda CR-V trims
Gas: LX $31,520, EX $33,550 and EX-L $35,800, with AWD for $1,500 more. Hybrid: Sport Hybrid $36,030, Sport-L Hybrid $39,125, TrailSport Hybrid $39,200 (AWD standard) and Sport Touring Hybrid $42,950 (AWD standard). Honda lists a $1,550 destination charge. The CR-V is the value play if you want comfort features: the EX adds a power moonroof, heated front seats and dual-zone climate control, and the EX-L adds leather-trimmed seats and a power tailgate. Browse new Honda CR-V inventory in NYC or the new CR-V Hybrid lineup.

## Price and Value
### 2026 Toyota RAV4 trims
LE $31,900 ($33,300 AWD), SE $34,700 ($36,100 AWD), XLE Premium $36,100 ($37,500 AWD), Woodland $39,900, XSE $41,300 and Limited $43,300, plus a $1,450 destination fee. A RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid starts at $42,950 including destination and can travel up to 52 miles on electricity. For the money, the RAV4 packs Toyota's reputation for quality, durability and reliability plus strong resale value. See new Toyota RAV4 inventory in NYC.
**What you pay for a moonroof and leather:** On the CR-V, the cheapest moonroof is the EX at $33,550 and the cheapest leather is the EX-L at $35,800; hybrid shoppers get leather in the Sport-L Hybrid at $39,125. On the RAV4, the cheapest verified roof is an XLE Premium ($36,100) with the $1,850 Panoramic Moonroof Package, about $37,950 before destination. The XSE includes a power moonroof and the Limited a panoramic roof. RAV4 upholstery on those trims is SofTex, Toyota's synthetic leather, not genuine leather.
Lease specials are updated every month, so check the current Honda lease specials (updated monthly) and Honda manufacturer incentives and rebates, plus the current Toyota lease specials (updated monthly) and Toyota manufacturer incentives and rebates. Trading in? Get a Kelley Blue Book Instant Cash Offer on your current car before you visit.
At the top of each lineup, the CR-V Sport Touring Hybrid adds a 12-speaker Bose system, Google built-in and a hands-free power tailgate for $42,950, while the RAV4 Limited adds a panoramic roof, ventilated front seats, heated rear seats and a 12.9-inch screen for $43,300.

## Performance and Fuel Economy in NYC Traffic
The 2026 Toyota RAV4 is the more efficient and more powerful SUV. Its hybrid system makes 226 hp with front-wheel drive and 236 hp with AWD, and the LE, SE and XLE Premium with front-wheel drive are EPA-rated 47 city/40 highway/43 combined mpg. That city number matters most in crawling traffic on the Cross Bronx or the BQE, where a hybrid runs on electric power at low speeds.
The 2027 Honda CR-V Hybrid makes 204 hp and is rated 43/36/40 mpg with front-wheel drive and 40/34/37 mpg with AWD; the TrailSport Hybrid, on all-terrain tires, is rated 38/33/35 mpg. The gas CR-V makes 190 hp and returns 28/33/30 mpg (27/31/29 with AWD). Honda's smart engineering makes the CR-V Hybrid smooth and responsive, and roughly a second quicker to 60 mph than the gas CR-V. If you want the lowest price and drive mostly highway miles to Long Island or New Jersey, the gas CR-V still makes sense.
What does that look like over a year? At 12,000 miles, an AWD RAV4 LE uses about 286 gallons, an AWD CR-V Hybrid about 324 gallons and an AWD gas CR-V about 414 gallons, based on EPA combined ratings. Both brands also offer AWD for winter storms and slushy side streets.
Heading to the Catskills or Hudson Valley for the weekend, both SUVs are relaxed highway cruisers. The RAV4's advantage grows on hilly, stop-and-go stretches, while the CR-V's quiet cabin and supportive seats make long drives easy.
On the highway, both SUVs cruise quietly. The RAV4 feels punchier thanks to its extra 22 to 32 horsepower, while the CR-V Hybrid feels smoother and more refined at speed.

## Performance and Fuel Economy in NYC Traffic
The RAV4's 8.1 inches of ground clearance, versus 7.8 inches for the CR-V Hybrid, helps over speed bumps and broken curbs, and Toyota's all-new chassis for 2026 is tuned for a calmer ride over NYC potholes.

## Size, Parking and Cargo Space
The 2026 Toyota RAV4 is easier to park; the 2027 Honda CR-V holds more. The RAV4 is 181.0 inches long with a 36.9-foot turning circle, 3.8 inches shorter than the 184.8-inch CR-V, which helps when you're squeezing into a spot during alternate-side parking or a tight garage. Want something smaller than either? See our Honda HR-V vs Honda CR-V comparison.
Inside, the CR-V wins clearly. The gas CR-V offers 39.3 cubic feet behind the rear seats and 76.5 cubic feet with them folded (hybrids list 36.3 cubic feet seats up), versus 37.8 and 69.8 cubic feet for the RAV4. Rear legroom is 41.0 inches in the CR-V and 37.8 inches in the RAV4, which makes a real difference with rear-facing car seats or on an airport run to JFK or LGA.
Both cargo areas handle a stroller and a week of groceries, but the CR-V's extra 6.7 cubic feet with the seats folded is what fits luggage for four on a Hamptons or Jersey Shore weekend.
For a camping trip upstate, both open wide enough to slide in a cooler and a tent bag. The CR-V's extra cargo space is what leaves room for chairs, sleeping bags and a second cooler.

## Interior, Tech and Comfort
The 2026 Toyota RAV4 has the bigger screens; the 2027 Honda CR-V has the nicer materials for the money. Every RAV4 gets a 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster and a 10.5-inch touchscreen, with a 12.9-inch screen on the XSE and Limited. Every CR-V gets a 9-inch touchscreen, with a 7-inch cluster on the LX, EX and Sport Hybrid and a 10.2-inch cluster from the EX-L up. Both have wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as standard.
The CR-V's leather-trimmed EX-L undercuts the RAV4's SofTex-trimmed XLE Premium by $300. SofTex is easy to wipe clean, which some families prefer, but only the CR-V offers genuine leather-trimmed seating.
Both dashboards are clean and driver-focused. The RAV4's wide digital cluster and larger screen feel more modern, while the CR-V keeps simple physical climate knobs that are easy to use in stop-and-go traffic.
Toyota's new multimedia system adds 5G connectivity and a built-in drive recorder, and the RAV4 Limited adds a nine-speaker JBL system. The CR-V Sport Touring Hybrid counters with Google built-in and a 12-speaker Bose system.
The CR-V's moonroof is a conventional one-touch power unit; the RAV4 offers a panoramic glass roof, but only as a package or on the Limited.

**Compare the 2026 Honda CR-V vs. 2026 Toyota RAV4: A Comprehensive Review**
Shopping for a compact SUV in West Michigan? The 2026 Honda CR-V and the 2026 Toyota RAV4 are two of the most recognizable names in the segment - and for good reason. Both are built for everyday practicality, with modern safety tech, comfortable cabins, and the kind of versatility that makes commuting, carpooling, and weekend trips feel easy.
On this page, we'll compare key areas like design, performance, fuel efficiency, interior space, technology, and long-term ownership. Our goal is simple: help you see where the 2026 Honda CR-V shines - so you can choose the SUV that fits your life with confidence.
**Compare Design and Styling of the 2026 Honda CR-V vs. 2026 Toyota RAV4**
********
*   **2026 Honda CR-V:**The 2026 Honda CR-V is designed to feel clean, modern, and ready for real life. From its confident stance to its refined details, CR-V balances a sporty look with everyday functionality. Depending on trim, you can find practical touches like roof rails and an available power tailgate that make it easier to load up gear, groceries, and everything in between.  
*   **2026 Toyota RAV4:**TToyota positions the 2026 RAV4 with multiple design themes across the lineup, including core, rugged, and sport-oriented looks. Toyota notes SUV-forward proportions and details like a hammerhead-style front end, contoured hood, and angular fenders, plus new LED signature taillights for a tech-forward feel.
**Verdict:**If you want a compact SUV that looks sharp without trying too hard, the 2026 Honda CR-V's clean, modern styling delivers a great balance - easy to love today, and easy to live with for years.
**Performance Comparison Between the 2026 Honda CR-V and 2026 Toyota RAV4**

*   **2026 Honda CR-V:**The 2026 Honda CR-V offers a responsive, turbocharged driving feel that's well-suited to daily Michigan driving and navigating winter weather. Honda lists a 190-horsepower turbocharged engine, and available Real Time AWD™ for added confidence when roads get slick.  
*   **2026 Toyota RAV4:**Most notably, the 2026 RAV4 has moved to a 100% electrified lineup (Hybrid or Plug-in Hybrid), with available front-wheel drive or electronic on-demand all-wheel drive depending on grade. The 2026 RAV4 is not available with a traditional gasoline-only engine.
**Verdict:**For drivers who don't want a hybrid compact SUV and prefer the straightforward feel of a turbocharged gas powertrain, the 2026 Honda CR-V is an excellent pick for real-world confidence and easy drivability.
**Fuel Efficiency: Comparing the 2026 Honda CR-V vs. 2026 Toyota RAV4**
*   **2026 Honda CR-V:**The 2026 Honda CR-V delivers strong efficiency for a gas-powered compact SUV. Honda lists EPA ratings as high as 28 city / 33 highway for 2WD models (and 27/31 for AWD). That's a great fit for commuters who want to keep fuel stops predictable without changing driving habits.  
*   **2026 Toyota RAV4:**The 2026 RAV4 does not offer a comparable gasoline only option. To compare how the electrified RAV4 stacks up against the 2026 CR-V Hybrid, check out our comparison on the competitors.
**Verdict:**One big advantage for CR-V shoppers: you can choose the powertrain that fits your priorities. The 2026 Honda CR-V offers an efficient turbo gas option with competitive EPA ratings - and if you want to explore electrified efficiency, Honda also offers CR-V Hybrid trims (we cover hybrid comparisons on a separate page).

*Based on 2025 EPA mileage and driving range ratings. Use for comparison purposes only. Your MPGe/MPG and driving range will vary depending on driving conditions, how you drive and maintain your vehicle, lithium-ion battery age/condition, and other factors. For additional information about EPA ratings, visit http://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/label/learn-more-PHEV-label.shtml.

Hey! Here’s our first look at the all-new 2023 Honda HR-V, which is based on the chassis of the new 11th-generation Civic.
The new second-generation HR-V is both longer and wider than the outgoing model, while also featuring more rear legroom and one of the largest cargo areas in its class. Overall length is up by 9.4 inches.

# Hey! Here’s our first look at the... - Kelley Blue Book | Facebook
One engine is available, a naturally aspirated 2.0-liter 4-cylinder that sends 158 horsepower to the front (or all four) wheels via a continuously variable automatic transmission.
The base model, a front-drive LX, starts at $23,650. This new HR-V is rated by the EPA at 26 mpg city/33 mpg highway/28 mpg combined.
